report.host_metric_scope: Current native session, including explicit delayed-ACK diagnostics; reset wait is separate. Worker resource maxima cover this transport lifetime. These are not steady-state physics-only costs.

package_identity.scope: Manifest byte readback; sealed package verification remains the launcher gate

replay.scope: Named operations and completed semantic ticks; incomplete barriers retained as incident evidence

report.scope: Standalone real World/Rapier asynchronous ownership rehearsal; not attached to the production Workbench
report.status: Tick 3600 completed with applied worker receipts
report.timing_scope: Latest bounded samples per current session. Input-to-result/publication/presented and receipt-roundtrip/semantic-interval are enclosing measures, not additive stages. Queue/native/snapshot/value-accounting/delivery are disjoint. Presentation is scene draw observation, not measured monitor scanout.

worker.byte_scope: Value payload sizes include packed buffers, scalar fields and UTF-32 strings; exclude container/allocator overhead and shared-copy deduplication. Godot static bytes are process-wide and exclude native std allocations.

timing.scope: Unpaced actual-host tick plus queued input completion; no target-display FPS claim
